about.text: Like most states, Indiana has long required candidates seeking a place on its general election ballot to first demonstrate a significant modicum of support among registered voters. A candidate can make such a demonstration by obtaining signatures numbering at least 2 percent of the total votes cast in their election district in the last election for the position of Secretary of State of Indiana.
